purpose: Verify that a valid Student Admin creates an open club.
preconditions: The Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
Valid student coordinator and co-coordinator records are available.
A valid faculty councillor record is available.
action_or_input: Enter a club name and description, select an allowed category, and select valid coordinator, co-coordinator, and Club Faculty Councillor assignments.
expected_result: The club is created with open status and successful creation is confirmed.

purpose: Verify that invalid leadership or faculty assignments are identified and corrected without club creation.
preconditions: The Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
Valid club name, description, and category data are available.
action_or_input: Attempt club creation with an invalid coordinator, co-coordinator, or Club Faculty Councillor.
expected_result: The system identifies the invalid assignment and permits correction; no club is created.

purpose: Verify that club categories outside the allowed set are not accepted.
preconditions: The Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
Valid leader and faculty assignments are available.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a club using a category other than Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
expected_result: The club is not created.

purpose: Verify that a club is not partially created when required data cannot be stored.
preconditions: The Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
Club input and assignments are otherwise valid.
Required club data storage fails.
action_or_input: Submit the complete club creation request.
expected_result: The system reports failure and no club record is successfully created.

purpose: Verify that an authorized Club Head books an available club session.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club exists and is confirmed.
A configured venue is available.
The requested venue and date have no conflicting booking.
action_or_input: Identify the club session venue and date, enter a valid start time, end time, and description, and optionally provide a poster.
expected_result: The session is stored, student notification is initiated, and the booking is confirmed.

purpose: Verify that a session overlapping an existing session or event is rejected.
preconditions: The actor is authorized for a confirmed club.
A session or event already occupies part or all of the requested venue, date, and time.
action_or_input: Attempt to book a session in the overlapping slot.
expected_result: The system rejects the booking and asks the actor to select another slot.

purpose: Verify that a session cannot be booked in an invalid venue.
preconditions: The actor is authorized for a confirmed club.
action_or_input: Submit a session booking with a venue that is not configured.
expected_result: No successful session booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 Exception E1 Invalid Time Range
purpose: Verify that an invalid session time range is rejected.
preconditions: The actor is authorized for a confirmed club.
A configured venue and date are selected.
action_or_input: Submit a session whose start time does not precede its end time.
expected_result: No successful session booking is recorded.

purpose: Verify that session storage failure prevents acceptance.
preconditions: The actor is authorized.
The venue and time range are valid.
Session storage fails.
action_or_input: Submit a valid, conflict-free session booking.
expected_result: No successful session booking is recorded.

purpose: Verify that notification processing failure before acceptance prevents successful session booking.
preconditions: The actor is authorized.
The venue and time range are valid.
Notification processing fails.
action_or_input: Submit a valid, conflict-free session booking.
expected_result: No successful session booking is recorded.

purpose: Verify that an authorized Club Head books an available club event.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable coordinator or co-coordinator.
The club exists and is confirmed.
A valid faculty context is available.
A configured venue is available.
The requested venue and date have no conflicting booking.
action_or_input: Enter event name and valid faculty context, select a venue and date, and enter a valid start time, end time, poster, and description.
expected_result: The event is stored, student notification is initiated, and the booking is confirmed.

purpose: Verify that an event overlapping an existing session or event is rejected.
preconditions: The actor is authorized for a confirmed club.
A session or event already occupies part or all of the requested venue, date, and time.
action_or_input: Attempt to book an event in the overlapping slot.
expected_result: The system rejects the booking and asks the actor to select another slot.

purpose: Verify that an event cannot be booked in an invalid venue.
preconditions: The actor is authorized for a confirmed club.
Faculty context and time range are otherwise valid.
action_or_input: Submit an event booking with a venue that is not configured.
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 Exception E1 Invalid Faculty Reference
purpose: Verify that an invalid faculty reference prevents event booking.
preconditions: The actor is authorized for a confirmed club.
Venue and time range are otherwise valid.
action_or_input: Submit an event with an invalid or missing Club Faculty Councillor or faculty reference.
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 Exception E1 Invalid Time Range
purpose: Verify that an invalid event time range is rejected.
preconditions: The actor is authorized for a confirmed club.
A configured venue and valid faculty context are selected.
action_or_input: Submit an event whose start time does not precede its end time.
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

purpose: Verify that event storage failure prevents acceptance.
preconditions: The actor is authorized.
Venue, faculty context, and time range are valid.
Event storage fails.
action_or_input: Submit a valid, conflict-free event booking.
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

purpose: Verify that an authenticated student submits an open application to a confirmed club.
preconditions: The student is authenticated.
The selected club exists and is confirmed.
The student has no existing application to the selected club.
action_or_input: Select a confirmed club and enter achievements or an application description.
expected_result: The system records an open membership application for the authenticated student and confirms submission.

purpose: Verify that a student may apply to a different club while retaining prior club applications.
preconditions: The student is authenticated.
The student has an existing application to one confirmed club.
A different confirmed club is available.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application to the different confirmed club.
expected_result: The new application is recorded as open and the existing application remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that a duplicate application to the same club is rejected.
preconditions: The student is authenticated.
An existing application to the selected club is present.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit another membership application to the same club.
expected_result: The duplicate is rejected and the existing application remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that membership applications are not accepted for an open club.
preconditions: The student is authenticated.
The selected club exists with open status.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a membership application to the open club.
expected_result: No membership application is created.

purpose: Verify that an applicable Club Head approves one open membership application.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable coordinator or co-coordinator.
An open application belongs to the actor's club.
action_or_input: Open pending applications, select an open application, optionally enter remarks, and approve it.
expected_result: The application changes from open to confirmed, remarks are stored if entered, and approval is confirmed.

purpose: Verify that multiple selected pending applications are evaluated independently.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable Club Head.
Multiple open applications belong to the actor's club.
action_or_input: Select multiple pending applications and approve them in one interaction.
expected_result: Each eligible open application changes independently to confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 Exception E1 Application No Longer Open
purpose: Verify that approval does not change a membership application that is no longer open.
preconditions: The actor is authorized for the club.
The selected application no longer has open status.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the non-open application.
expected_result: The application remains in its prior state and is not changed.

purpose: Verify that a Club Head cannot approve an application belonging to another club.
preconditions: The actor is authorized for one club.
A pending application belongs to another club.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the application belonging to the other club.
expected_result: The application remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that an authorized Club Head creates a valid targeted poll.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable coordinator or co-coordinator.
A valid expiration date is available.
Valid batch and branch targets are available.
At least two choices are available.
action_or_input: Enter poll title and description, expiration date, at least two choices, and target groups by batch and branch.
expected_result: The active poll and choices are created, the target audience is determined, notifications are initiated, and creation is confirmed.

purpose: Verify that an all-branches selection represents every configured branch for a selected batch.
preconditions: The actor is authorized.
The all-branches option is configured for the selected batch.
A valid expiration date and at least two choices are available.
action_or_input: Create a poll for a batch using the all-branches target option.
expected_result: The poll is created with every configured branch for that batch in its target audience.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 Exception E1 Fewer Than Two Choices
purpose: Verify that a poll with fewer than two choices is not created.
preconditions: The actor is authorized.
Valid title, description, expiration date, and target information are available.
action_or_input: Submit a poll definition containing fewer than two choices.
expected_result: The poll is rejected and no poll or choices are created.

purpose: Verify that invalid target information prevents poll creation.
preconditions: The actor is authorized.
The poll has a valid expiration date and at least two choices.
action_or_input: Submit the poll with invalid or missing batch or branch target information.
expected_result: The poll is not created.

purpose: Verify that an eligible student casts one vote and updates the poll tally.
preconditions: The student is authenticated.
The poll is active and unexpired.
The student belongs to a target group.
The student has not already voted.
action_or_input: Open the active poll and select one choice.
expected_result: One vote is recorded for the student, the poll tally is updated, the student is marked as having voted, and success is confirmed.

purpose: Verify that a student cannot vote twice in the same poll.
preconditions: The student is authenticated and eligible.
The poll is active.
The student has already voted.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit another choice in the poll.
expected_result: The vote is rejected and the tally remains unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 Exception E1 Student Not Eligible
purpose: Verify that a student outside the target audience cannot vote.
preconditions: The student is authenticated.
The poll is active.
The student belongs to no target group.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a vote in the poll.
expected_result: The vote is rejected and the tally remains unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 Exception E1 Poll Not Active
purpose: Verify that a student cannot vote in an inactive or expired poll.
preconditions: The student is authenticated and belongs to a target group.
The poll is inactive or expired.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a choice.
expected_result: The vote is rejected and the tally remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that authorized current leadership is replaced consistently.
preconditions: The actor is an applicable current Club Head.
The club exists.
Both proposed leaders are valid students.
Current leadership assignments are recorded.
action_or_input: Submit a new valid coordinator and co-coordinator for the club.
expected_result: The club references only the new coordinator and co-coordinator; their current designations are recorded, superseded designations are retired, and success is confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 Exception E1 Invalid Proposed Leader
purpose: Verify that invalid proposed leadership leaves existing leadership unchanged.
preconditions: The actor is authorized.
The club has existing valid leadership.
action_or_input: Submit a leadership change with an invalid proposed coordinator or co-coordinator.
expected_result: The change is rejected and existing leadership remains intact.

purpose: Verify that an unauthorized actor cannot change club leadership.
preconditions: The actor is not an applicable current Club Head.
The club has existing valid leadership.
Both proposed leaders are valid students.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a leadership change.
expected_result: The change is rejected and existing leadership remains intact.

purpose: Verify that an applicable Club Head submits a valid budget request for tracking.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable Club Head.
The club exists and is confirmed.
The budget amount is non-negative.
The required supporting file is available.
action_or_input: Enter budget purpose, a non-negative amount, upload the required supporting file, and enter a description.
expected_result: The request is stored with open status and successful submission is confirmed.

purpose: Verify that a negative budget amount is rejected and not stored.
preconditions: The actor is authorized for a confirmed club.
The required supporting file is present.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with a negative amount.
expected_result: The request is rejected and not stored as a valid submission.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 Exception E1 Missing Supporting File
purpose: Verify that a budget request cannot be submitted without its supporting file.
preconditions: The actor is authorized for a confirmed club.
The entered budget amount is non-negative.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request without the required supporting file.
expected_result: The request is rejected and not stored as a valid submission.

purpose: Verify that an applicable Club Head submits a complete club event report.
preconditions: The actor is the applicable Club Head.
The relevant club event or activity has occurred.
Club, student incharge, event details, and report file are available.
action_or_input: Identify the club and student incharge, enter event name, description and date/time, and upload the required report/details file.
expected_result: The event report is stored in the club repository and submission is confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-010 Exception E1 Missing Report File
purpose: Verify that an event report without the required report/details file is rejected.
preconditions: The actor is authorized.
The textual event references and details are otherwise valid.
action_or_input: Submit the event report without uploading the required report/details file.
expected_result: The report is not accepted or stored.

source_id: UC-GYM-010 Exception E1 Invalid Required References
purpose: Verify that missing or invalid report references prevent submission.
preconditions: The report/details file is available.
action_or_input: Submit an event report with missing or invalid club, student incharge, or event references.
expected_result: The report is not accepted or stored.

purpose: Verify that a Student Admin confirms an open club.
preconditions: The Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
The selected club exists with open status.
action_or_input: Open the club record, review its information and assignments, and approve the club.
expected_result: The club status changes from open to confirmed and approval is confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-011 Exception E1 Club Not Open
purpose: Verify that a club not in open status cannot undergo approval.
preconditions: The Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
The selected club exists with a status other than open.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the club.
expected_result: No status transition occurs and the club retains its prior status.

purpose: Verify that club approval fails safely when its status cannot be updated.
preconditions: The Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
The selected club is open.
Club status storage fails.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the open club.
expected_result: No status transition occurs and the club remains open.

purpose: Verify that an assigned Club Faculty Councillor accesses and reviews the club's submitted reports.
preconditions: The faculty user is authenticated.
The faculty user is the assigned Club Faculty Councillor for the club.
At least one submitted event report exists for the club.
action_or_input: Open the club report area and select a submitted report.
expected_result: The submitted reports for the assigned club are listed and the selected report metadata and report/details file are available for review.

purpose: Verify that a faculty user not assigned to a club cannot access its reports.
preconditions: The faculty user is authenticated.
The faculty user is not the assigned councillor for the selected club.
At least one report exists for the club.
action_or_input: Attempt to open the club report area or select a report.
expected_result: Access is denied and no unauthorized report content or file is exposed.
